text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before the race, Seiun Sky thanked King 
Halo for giving her the opportunity to 
make a comeback.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And in the paddock— She makes her first 
formal declaration of war against Special 
Week. The battle of the Big Three begins 
once more—!
